terms.004: These Terms of Use (“Terms”) govern your use of the iOS app 专注艺术馆 (Attention Museum, the “App”), provided by the Attention Museum developer (“we”, “us”). terms.006: The App is a focus timer presented as a museum visit. You choose a hall and a duration and keep the App in the foreground; when the session completes, the artwork is added to a collection stored on your device. No account is required. Locking the device or leaving the App pauses the session; returning within 30 seconds resumes it, and a longer absence ends it. The in-app “Focus Rules” describe the current rules.
terms.008: The free version includes four halls (Landscape, Portrait, Still Life and the first special exhibition) and 15, 25 and 45-minute sessions. Attention Museum Pro adds the Oriental Ink and Impressionism halls, additional session lengths and collection poster export. Pro is offered as a monthly subscription, an annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the App before purchase and may vary by region.
terms.010: Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
terms.011: Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the then-current price.
terms.012: You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your device’s Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions, or from the App’s settings. Deleting the App does not cancel a subscription. After cancellation, Pro remains active until the end of the paid period.
terms.013: If a free trial is offered, any unused portion is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
terms.014: The lifetime purchase is a one-time, non-renewing purchase that remains valid for as long as the App is offered.
terms.015: All payments are processed by Apple. Refund requests are handled by Apple under its policies at reportaproblem.apple.com; we cannot issue refunds directly.
terms.016: Use “Restore Purchases” to recover an active Pro entitlement on a new device. Restoring does not recover deleted collections or focus history, which exist only on your device.
terms.017: If Pro expires, you keep your existing collection and can still preview Pro halls; starting new Pro sessions, using additional durations and exporting posters require an active entitlement.

index.001: An iPhone focus timer. Choose a gallery, spend some quiet time with a painting, and add it to your collection. No account; your data stays on your device.
index.002: Six galleries, 48 public-domain masterpieces. Collect an artwork with each completed session.
index.011: One focus session. One masterpiece on your wall.

index.016: Replace your timer with a quiet gallery wall
index.017: No progress rings, scores or pop-up reminders. Just a painting, a numbered plaque and a quiet countdown.
index.019: Swipe between six galleries. Each holds eight paintings with its own framing style.
index.021: 15, 25 or 45 minutes. Tap the plaque to read about the artwork without interrupting your timer.

index.054: Open and start. No sign-up, login, social feeds or leaderboards.
index.056: Focus history and collections stay on your iPhone. No cloud sync, ads or behavioral tracking.
index.058: Locking or leaving pauses the timer. Return within 30 seconds to resume; otherwise the session ends. The same painting stays for a fresh start.

index.064: Walls and lighting stay the same at the start and finish. No flashes, particles or progress bars.

index.084: Reference prices in CNY; your App Store price applies. Monthly and annual plans renew automatically and can be cancelled in App Store account settings. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Existing collections remain accessible after expiry.
index.087: Can I switch to another app while focusing?
index.088: Briefly. The timer pauses in the background or when locked; time away does not count. Return within 30 seconds to resume automatically. A longer absence interrupts the session. System dialogs do not interrupt it.
index.090: EXIT asks you to confirm. Ending adds no artwork, but the painting stays in place for a new full session.
index.091: Will my collection survive a new phone or reinstall?
index.092: Collections are local and are deleted with the app. Restore Purchases can recover Pro access, but not collections or focus history.
index.093: Do I need an internet connection?
index.094: The first viewing downloads an image. Cached artworks work offline; losing connection after a session starts does not affect completion.
index.096: Images are public-domain artworks from The Met’s Open Access program. Chinese titles are our translations; artwork details retain original titles, sources and credits.
index.097: How do I cancel a subscription?
index.098: On iPhone, go to Settings → your Apple Account → Subscriptions, or manage subscriptions in the app’s settings. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.

agreement.004: Welcome to Attention Museum. This agreement governs your use of the iOS app (the “App”) with its developer (“we”). Please pay particular attention to clauses in bold. Downloading, installing or using the App means you have read and accepted this agreement and the Privacy Policy.
agreement.006: The App is a focus timer built around viewing art. Choose a gallery and duration and keep the App in the foreground. On completion, the artwork is added to your device’s collection wall.
agreement.007: No account is required. Focus history, collections and settings are stored only on your device; see the Privacy Policy.
agreement.008: Locking or leaving pauses the timer; time away does not count. Returning within 30 seconds resumes it; a longer absence interrupts the session. Each work is collected only on first completion. Refer to the in-app Focus Rules for the current rules.
agreement.009: We may adjust, add or discontinue features, galleries or works as the product evolves, with reasonable advance notice.
agreement.011: Free access includes Landscapes, Portraits, Still Life and the Opening Exhibition, with 15, 25 and 45-minute sessions.
agreement.012: Pro adds East Asian Ink, Impressionism, more durations and poster export. It is available monthly, annually or as a lifetime purchase. The price shown on the App Store purchase page applies.
agreement.013: Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase confirmation. Unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours before the current period ends, renewal is charged within the final 24 hours at the then-current price.
agreement.014: Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions, or through the App’s settings. Deleting the App does not cancel subscriptions. Pro remains available until the paid period ends after cancellation.
agreement.015: Lifetime is a one-time purchase, valid while the App continues to be offered, with no automatic renewal.
agreement.016: Apple processes all purchases and refunds under its policies. Request refunds from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue refunds directly.
agreement.017: After reinstalling or changing devices, use Restore Purchases to recover active Pro access. Restoring cannot recover deleted collections or focus history.
agreement.018: After Pro expires, collections and Pro gallery previews remain viewable. New Pro sessions, additional durations and poster export require active access; additional durations revert to 25 minutes.
agreement.020: Artwork images are public-domain works from The Met’s Open Access program. Chinese titles, viewing prompts and descriptions are written by us. Original titles, sources and credits are retained in artwork details.
agreement.021: The software, interface, frame and wall assets, text and icons belong to us or their rights holders. We grant a personal, non-transferable, non-exclusive license to use the App on Apple devices you own or control, under App Store usage rules.
agreement.022: Without permission, do not reverse engineer, decompile or disassemble the App except where law expressly permits; copy, sell, rent or commercially exploit the App or its non-public-domain content; or bypass payment mechanisms to obtain Pro.
agreement.024: Use the App lawfully. Do not use it for unlawful activities or disrupt the App or related servers, including museum image servers, for example with automated bulk image requests.
agreement.026: The App helps you set aside focused time. It offers no medical, psychological or learning advice or guarantees. Consult a professional about attention, sleep or health concerns.
agreement.027: Image downloads depend on third-party servers and your connection and may fail temporarily due to service changes or network faults. Sessions do not start until images are ready.
agreement.028: Data stays only on your device. We cannot recover losses caused by deleting the App, resetting progress, replacing or losing a device, system faults or similar events.

privacy.001: Attention Museum Privacy Policy: no account; focus history and collections stay on your device.
privacy.004: Attention Museum requires no account and contains no ads or third-party analytics. Focus history, collections and preferences stay only on your iPhone; we cannot view them.
privacy.005: Network access is used only to download artwork images and process Pro purchases through the App Store and RevenueCat.
privacy.006: This policy covers the Attention Museum iOS app (the “App”) and this website, provided by the Attention Museum developer (“we”). Read it before use and contact us using the details below with any questions.
privacy.008: We require no name, phone number, email or other identity information and provide no account system.
privacy.009: The App has no advertising SDK, third-party analytics or crash reporting, cross-app tracking or tracking permission requests.
privacy.010: The App does not access contacts, photos, location, microphone or camera.
privacy.012: The following stays in the local app sandbox and is not uploaded to our servers. We do not operate servers for user data:
privacy.016: Start time, duration and completion/interruption status, for timing, session recovery and collection progress.
privacy.018: Collected works and images, for the collection wall and offline viewing.
privacy.020: Current artwork, selected duration, browsing position, whether onboarding has been read, and similar preferences.
privacy.022: Reflections written in early versions, if any. They remain locally for compatibility; the current version neither displays nor edits them.
privacy.023: Settings → Reset All Progress clears collections, focus history, badges and gallery progress, without affecting membership. Deleting the App removes all local data. Deleted data cannot be recovered. If iCloud or computer backups are enabled, Apple may include local data in device backups; Apple controls this and we cannot access them.
privacy.026: Images are downloaded from public museum servers, currently The Metropolitan Museum of Art (images.metmuseum.org). As with any website, requests may reveal your IP address, request time and app identifier, such as AttentionMuseum/0.1. We send no identity-related information. The museum’s privacy policy governs its handling of those requests.
privacy.028: Apple handles payments through the App Store; we receive no payment-card or Apple Account details. The App uses RevenueCat, Inc.’s subscription service to verify Pro access:
privacy.029: RevenueCat generates an anonymous app user ID, unrelated to your identity;
privacy.030: It processes purchases and transactions (product, price, currency, purchase and expiry times), App Store receipts, and basic device/app technical data such as OS and app versions, region, language and IP address;
privacy.031: Use is limited to validating and restoring purchases, checking Pro access and displaying subscription management.
privacy.032: RevenueCat is based in the United States and may process information outside China, under its Privacy Policy. If subscriptions are disabled, the App does not initialize RevenueCat or send related network requests.
privacy.034: The App may request notification permission only for local reminders when you leave a session. They are generated on-device, with no push service or device-token uploads. Declining does not change timing rules; change permission anytime in system settings.
privacy.036: Pro users can export posters created locally. A poster is sent only after you choose a destination in the system share sheet; recipients are responsible for their handling of the content.
privacy.038: Apart from Apple for payments, RevenueCat for entitlements and museum servers for image downloads, we do not share, sell, rent or publicly disclose your personal information. We cooperate with lawful requests from authorities only as necessary.
privacy.040: You can view, clear or delete most information directly on your device. Contact us for help requesting access, correction or deletion of RevenueCat’s anonymous purchase records. You can cancel subscriptions in the App Store and disable notifications in system settings. We respond within 15 working days.
privacy.042: The App is for the general public and is not specifically directed at children under 14. If under 14, read this policy with a guardian and obtain their consent before use; a guardian must handle purchases.
privacy.044: Local data is protected by the iOS sandbox and device encryption. We store no focus or collection data on servers, so have no server-side retention period. Local data remains until you clear it or delete the App. RevenueCat retains purchase records under its policies and applicable law.
privacy.046: If data processing changes, such as new network features, we will update this policy and its date. Material changes will be highlighted in the App or on this website.
privacy.048: For questions, comments or requests about this policy or your personal information, contact:
